description: Player carries the ball while taking three steps without dribbling

input.situation_description: A player catches a pass near the three-point line and takes three full steps toward the basket without dribbling before attempting a layup.

description: Defender blocks driving player without established position

input.situation_description: A defender slides into the path of a driving ball handler at the last moment, causing a collision. The defender's feet were still moving when contact occurred.

rationale: Blocking foul - defender did not establish legal guarding position per Art 33

description: Offensive player charges into set defender

input.situation_description: An offensive player drives to the basket and runs directly into a defender who had both feet planted and was stationary before the offensive player began the drive.

rationale: Charging foul - defender had established legal guarding position per Art 33

description: Player stops dribble then dribbles again

input.situation_description: A point guard dribbles up the court, picks up the ball with both hands, then begins dribbling again to drive past the defender.

rationale: Double dribble violation per FIBA Art 24

description: Defender blocks a shot while the ball is descending toward the rim

input.situation_description: A defender jumps to block a mid-range shot. The ball had already reached its highest point and was clearly on its way down toward the rim when the defender touched it.
